member.name: OdooRepository
member.summary:
Typed access to one Odoo model: queries, create, update, delete and actions for records of . The Odoo table comes from on .
Uses underneath, so it logs in automatically and returns errors in instead of throwing them.
member.typeparam: Model class with and [JsonProperty] on properties.

member.name: IOdooRepository
member.summary: Typed access to one Odoo model: queries, create, update and delete for records of . Implemented by ; useful for mocking in tests.
member.typeparam: Model class with and [JsonProperty] on properties.

member.name: TableName
member.summary: Odoo model name of , e.g. res.partner.

member.name: OdooClient
member.summary: Client used to send requests - available for derived repositories with custom calls.

member.name: Config
member.summary: Connection settings of the underlying . Change to set default language or company.

member.name: Query
member.summary: Starts a new query for records of the model. Chain filters, ordering, paging and field selection, then execute it with e.g. ToListAsync, FirstOrDefaultAsync or CountAsync.
member.returns: New query builder; each call returns an independent query.

member.name: ctor
member.summary: Creates repository that uses the shared built-in HttpClient.

member.name: ctor.HttpClient
member.summary: Creates repository that sends requests using given HttpClient (e.g. from IHttpClientFactory).
member.param: HttpClient used to send requests, or null for the built-in one.

member.name: ctor.OdooClient
member.summary: Creates repository that uses an existing client - e.g. to share its HttpClient and configuration between repositories.

member.name: CreateAsync.Model
member.summary: Creates one record (Odoo create) from a model class. The table comes from the model's .
member.returns: Id of the created record, or failed result (e.g. Odoo ValidationError).

member.name: CreateAsync.Dictionary
member.summary: Creates one record (Odoo create) with only the fields present in the dictionary. A dictionary without table name is created in this repository's table.
member.returns: Id of the created record, or failed result.

member.name: CreateAsync.Models
member.summary: Creates many records in one request. All models must belong to the same Odoo table.
member.returns: Ids of created records in the same order as the models.

member.name: CreateAsync.Dictionaries
member.summary: Creates many records from dictionaries in one request. Dictionaries without table name are created in this repository's table.
member.returns: Ids of created records in the same order as the models.

member.name: UpdateAsync.Model
member.summary: Updates one record (Odoo write) with all properties of the model. To change only some fields use the overload.
member.returns: true when saved, or failed result.

member.name: UpdateAsync.Dictionary
member.summary: Updates one record (Odoo write) with only the fields present in the dictionary; a null value clears the field. A dictionary without table name updates this repository's table.
member.returns: true when saved, or failed result.

member.name: UpdateRangeAsync.Model
member.summary: Writes the same values (all properties of the model) to many records in one request (Odoo write).
member.returns: true when saved, or failed result.

member.name: UpdateRangeAsync.Dictionary
member.summary: Writes the fields present in the dictionary to many records in one request (Odoo write). Always targets this repository's table - of the dictionary is overwritten.
member.returns: true when saved, or failed result.

member.name: DeleteAsync.Model
member.summary: Deletes the record represented by the model (Odoo unlink), using its .
member.returns: true when deleted, or failed result (e.g. record is referenced and cannot be deleted).

member.name: DeleteAsync.Id
member.summary: Deletes one record of this repository's table by id (Odoo unlink).
member.returns: true when deleted, or failed result.

member.name: DeleteRangeAsync
member.summary: Deletes many records in one request (Odoo unlink). Nothing is deleted when any record cannot be deleted.
member.returns: true when deleted, or failed result.

member.name: ActionAsync
member.summary: Calls a public method of this repository's Odoo model, e.g. action_archive. The arguments are sent as the single positional argument - usually record id(s).
member.returns: Raw value returned by the method (often true, null or an action dictionary).
